_README: The allow-listed source set for the exercise library's per-block evidence review (#5778, scripts/library_evidence_review.py). A proposed library change is admitted only when its citation came through an allow-listed channel, is a peer-reviewed record with a DOI or PMID, and resolves LIVE (Crossref for a DOI, PubMed E-utilities for a PMID) with a matching title, first author and year. Social media, blogs, podcasts, video and any bare URL are never a source. Adding a channel, a design or a reviewer is a reviewed PR to this file, never a runtime edit. Doc: docs/coaching/EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md (Evidence review).

channels.pubmed: a PubMed record found by search or read directly (identifier: PMID, verified via E-utilities esummary)
channels.crossref: a DOI-registered journal article (identifier: DOI, verified via api.crossref.org/works)
channels.reviewer: a peer-reviewed paper surfaced by a named evidence-based reviewer below; the paper itself is still the source and is still verified by DOI/PMID — the reviewer's post, video or newsletter never is

randomized_trial.what: a randomized trial (parallel or within-subject) that measured hypertrophy

controlled_trial.what: a non-randomized controlled training study that measured hypertrophy

systematic_review.what: a systematic review of training trials

narrative_review.what: a peer-reviewed narrative review; admitted only when an author is a named reviewer below; backs `consensus` evidence at most, never a band move

position_stand.what: a peer-reviewed position stand; admitted only when an author is a named reviewer below; backs `consensus` evidence at most, never a band move

evidence_backing_requires.why: the library's evidence rule (deploy/exercise_library_curation.py, #5857): a row with evidence above none_reviewed cites a reference whose PMID resolved in PubMed AND whose abstract was read; only an rct_direct row may move one band off its rubric tier. A DOI-only record (Crossref, not PubMed-indexed) can be registered but backs no evidence, the way stasinaki2018 and wolf2023 already are.

reviewers._rule: Named evidence-based reviewers, matched against the verified record's author list as '<Surname> <Initials>'. A name here admits that person's PEER-REVIEWED output only (a DOI/PMID record); it never admits a blog, a post or a video by them.
